newsitem.title: USA: Eastman Chem quits olefins plant venture.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Chem quits olefins plant venture.

text.p: Eastman Chemicals Co said on Thursday it would not be a partner in the venture to build a two-billion-pound-capacity olefins plant in Texas.
The other three partners in the venture said they would meet to evaluate their options, including building the plant with or without a fourth partner and changing the capacity of the plant.
Eastman said the plant offered an attractive cost structure but did not fit into adjusted company plans.

"After thoroughly examining the company's olefins sourcing strategy, Eastman has decided to move away from a fully integrated olefins position to a net buyer position for growth in our olefins needs," it said.

In July Eastman signed a letter of intent to participate in the venture. The other partners are Lyondell Petrochemical Co, Union Carbide Corp, and Quantum Chemical Corp, a subsidiary of Millennium Chemicals Inc.
The three remaining partners said other companies were interested in joining the venture.
